title: PriceChanged
description: Emitted by the Catalog service when a product's price is updated. Consumed by any service caching prices (Totem, Order). Minor/patch evolution stays in this file via schemaVersion (ADR 0005); breaking changes go to a new events/vN/ path (ADR 0007).

eventId.description: = messageId do outbox; chave de deduplicação at-least-once

previousPrice.description: Price in BRL before the change.

newPrice.description: Price in BRL after the change.
